name: infographic
description: Design, create, or improve an infographic, visual explainer, illustrated guide, comparison poster, process graphic, or data story for any audience. Use for turning evidence and ideas into a clear, polished visual explanation, including choosing information structure, visual encoding, and a distinct aesthetic. Do not use for standalone decorative artwork, complete brand identity systems, statistical analysis alone, or ordinary document formatting.

findings.excerpt: Install with `npx skills add magnus919/agent-skills --skill infographic --agent codex --global --yes`,
